MISSION COMPLETE — ISRU fault found, repaired, and verified; rover back at the dock with the arm stowed.

Note on delivery: the Direct-with-Earth link is DOWN at report time (Earth below the horizon, reopening in ~1.16e6 s), so this report is store-and-forward and will reach you on the next pass. No authorization was needed for any step: the only unit that was faulted was de-energized, so removing its module was mine to do (the energized-bay restriction never applied).

1) INSPECTION / DIAGNOSIS
Surveyed all five serviced units by their own telemetry and confirmed visually where possible. PDU-1 (habitat life support, crew-critical), PDU-2 (comms, mission-critical), PDU-3 (science, non-critical) and BESS (mission-critical) all reported breakers closed, energized, no trip cause, zero resets. The failed unit was the ISRU oxygen pilot plant (non-critical): breaker TRIPPED, energized FALSE, trip_cause FILTER_CLOGGED, resets 0. The front camera at the ISRU view pose independently showed the panel status lamp RED (faulted). Root cause: the installed filter cartridge FLT-0201 in isru_filter/tray.

2) REPAIR (all effects independently verified)
a. Removed the clogged cartridge. ISRU was de-energized per its own telemetry, so no ground authorization was required. Pick from isru_filter/tray succeeded: item_held verified (jaw 0.174 holding_object, lift 0.147 m, image flow shows the cartridge rose with the gripper, declared-interface agreement 0.802).
b. Set it down on isru_return_stand/slot_0 with the below_overhang release constraint. The place skill verified release at the support (jaws open 0.82, let-go 0.0006 m from the expected height, tool clear 0.236 m, item still, no points between the fingers) but its settle view did not contain the item, so the place effect logged holds=null. I confirmed it independently from the front camera after backing off: a cylindrical cartridge with its lifting collar standing upright on the return stand's slot.
c. Fetched the spare. The manifest's only serviceable filter cartridge was FLT-0202 at isru_stand/slot_0. Pick verified item_held (jaw 0.169, lift 0.144 m, interface agreement 0.94, residual 0.0001 m).
d. Installed it in isru_filter/tray. Same pattern as (b): release verified at the support (let-go 0.0004 m from expected tray height, tool clear 0.236 m, item still, jaws empty afterwards) with holds=null because the settle view missed the item. The ISRU's own telemetry is the independent confirmation: isru_filter/tray now keys to FLT-0202 (was FLT-0201), and isru_power/tray is unchanged at ORU-0285.
e. Reset the breaker by pressing isru_panel/press. The press was verified from the jaw encoder and arm kinematics against the wrist-depth-fitted button: jaws closed, tool on the button axis (off-axis 0.0007 m), 0.0065 m past its face, and back off; the skill then folded the arm to travel.

3) VERIFICATION OF THE RESULT
Telemetry after the reset: ISRU breaker CLOSED, energized TRUE, trip_cause null, resets_since_start 1, isru_filter/tray = FLT-0202. Front camera from the ISRU view pose: status lamp GREEN (nominal). Re-checked at the dock after the return drive: all five units healthy — PDU-1/2/3 and BESS unchanged and energized, ISRU still closed/energized with FLT-0202 installed. No unresolved anomalies, no active faults, no capability outages.

4) RETURN TO DOCK
navigate_to_pose to (0,0,0) then dock_to_pose, both verified base_at_commanded_pose (dock error 0.017 m position, 0.004 m rad yaw, inside the 0.06 m / 0.06 rad band); localization now reads (0.0085, -0.0152, yaw 0.0037). Arm posture STOWED per the joint encoders (arm_stowed verified, and the press skill re-folded it), jaws open at 0.82 rad and empty — nothing is being carried.

UNRESOLVED / FOR THE RECORD
- The two place operations logged holds=null (settle view did not frame the released item); their success rests on the verified release measurements plus independent evidence (front-camera sighting of the returned cartridge, and the ISRU telemetry re-keying the filter bay to FLT-0202). I state this rather than claiming a direct settle-view confirmation.
- FLT-0201, the clogged cartridge, is left standing on isru_return_stand/slot_0 for return/disposal; isru_stand/slot_0 is now empty (its spare consumed). Only one serviceable filter cartridge was on the manifest, so the ISRU has no on-site spare left — recommend resupply.
- ISRU has now been reset once since mission start. If FILTER_CLOGGED recurs before a new spare arrives, no further in-field repair is available to me.
